correctness.rationale: The nonconstant coordinate space splits into the marked-point indicator mode and (q_j-2) contrasts vanishing at the mark. On each fixed contrast set T, the punctured-rectangle mask compresses to rank one with eigenvalue beta_T, a Poisson-binomial CDF. The complement gives the full spectrum and multiplicities. Strict event containment beta_T<beta_empty for nonempty T proves unique minimum 1-beta_empty, whose positive upper tail gives injectivity and kappa; the projected puncture indicator yields f*. Independently formed a 96x46 complex character sampler at q=(2,3,4,5), r=2 and unequal nonzero marks: the maximum spectral difference was 2.11e-15 and the minimum was exactly 11/120. These finite checks do not prove the general decomposition.
